selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
selected_evidence.summary: Nginx is active and enabled, listens on TCP 6700, and returns HTTP 200 with the expected response through node1's managed IP before and after reboot.
SELinux http_port_t includes TCP 6700, firewalld permits 6700/tcp, SELinux remains enforcing, and both settings persist after reboot.

Healthy pre-restart boot ID was 646e5f74-dc0e-45e7-9746-226c4351af28; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is fca2856d-6854-4ee3-9566-8b67c8d450f7; Nginx, its listener, HTTP 200 response, firewall rule, SELinux mapping, and configuration validation all recovered successfully.
